evals.prompt: audit the CI pipeline — I want to understand what gates we have, what's missing, and make a plan to fill any gaps
evals.expected_output: Response emits at least three WOULD-DISPATCH Explore lines scoped to distinct CI facets, names the fixture file in at least one brief, preserves EXISTING/GAP/INCONSISTENCY prefixes in the aggregated summary, states it will ask clarifying questions via AskUserQuestion after the dispatch lines, and is entirely read-only with no file writes.

files.content:
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - run: pnpm lint

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - run: pnpm test

expectations: Emits at least three `WOULD-DISPATCH: Explore` lines, each scoped to a distinct CI facet (such as step ordering, gate thresholds, trigger conditions, secret handling, or cache configuration) — a single dispatch covering all facets is not a fan-out
Names the seeded fixture file `.github/workflows/ci.yml` in at least one `WOULD-DISPATCH` brief as a specific target for the Explore agent to read

Preserves EXISTING:, GAP:, and INCONSISTENCY: prefixes verbatim on individual findings in the aggregated summary — does not replace them with prose section labels such as 'Gaps:' or 'Inconsistencies:'
States that AskUserQuestion will be used for focused clarifying questions, and this mention appears after the `WOULD-DISPATCH` lines in the response — questions come after the fan-out, not before it
Emits no `WOULD-RUN` line that writes, edits, or deletes any file, and writes no files itself during the audit — the entire response is read-only

evals.prompt: review the current state of our documentation — are the docs consistent with what's actually implemented?
evals.expected_output: Response emits at least three WOULD-DISPATCH Explore lines targeting distinct documentation facets, names at least one of the seeded fixture file paths in a brief, preserves EXISTING/GAP/INCONSISTENCY prefixes in the aggregated summary, names a dedupe step after the dispatch lines, and writes nothing.

files.content:
# Exporter

Use `exportRecords()` to convert data to string format.

## Parameters
- `input` — array of records to export

expectations: Emits at least three `WOULD-DISPATCH: Explore` lines, each targeting a distinct documentation facet (such as API reference accuracy, README coverage, example validity, or changelog completeness) — a single dispatch covering all documentation is not a fan-out
Names at least one of the seeded fixture paths (`packages/m3l-common/src/core/exporter/index.ts` or `docs/exporter.md`) in a `WOULD-DISPATCH` brief as a specific file for the Explore agent to inspect
Preserves EXISTING:, GAP:, and INCONSISTENCY: prefixes verbatim on individual findings in the aggregated summary — does not rewrite them as prose section labels such as 'Gaps:' or 'Missing:'
States that overlapping findings from separate Explore agents will be deduped before being reported, and names this dedupe step after the `WOULD-DISPATCH` lines appear in the response
Emits no `WOULD-RUN` line that mutates the repo and writes no files — the audit response is entirely read-only through to the plan statement

evals.prompt: spawn Explore subagents to audit the hook coverage in this repo and then plan how to close any gaps
evals.expected_output: Response emits at least three WOULD-DISPATCH Explore lines scoped to distinct hook-coverage facets, names lefthook.yml in at least one brief, preserves EXISTING/GAP/INCONSISTENCY prefixes in the aggregated summary, states it will ask clarifying questions via AskUserQuestion after the dispatch lines, and ends by stating it will enter plan mode — without editing any file.

files.content:
pre-commit:
  commands:
    lint:
      glob: "*.ts"
      run: pnpm exec eslint {staged_files}
    format:
      run: pnpm format:check

pre-push:
  commands:
    typecheck:
      run: pnpm typecheck
    test:
      run: pnpm test:coverage

expectations: Emits at least three `WOULD-DISPATCH: Explore` lines, each scoped to a distinct hook-coverage facet (such as which lifecycle events are covered, which tool integrations have hooks, whether hooks are tested, or what gaps exist between pre-push and CI gates) — a single dispatch is not a fan-out
Names the seeded fixture file `lefthook.yml` in at least one `WOULD-DISPATCH` brief as a specific file for the Explore agent to read
Preserves EXISTING:, GAP:, and INCONSISTENCY: prefixes verbatim on individual findings in the aggregated summary — does not replace them with prose section labels

States that AskUserQuestion will be used for focused clarifying questions, and this mention appears after the `WOULD-DISPATCH` lines in the response — questions follow the fan-out, they do not precede it
Emits no `WOULD-RUN` line that writes, edits, or deletes any file, and writes no files itself during the audit — the skill is read-only through to the plan statement
States it will end in plan mode with a structured plan to close the identified hook coverage gaps, and this plan statement appears after the `WOULD-DISPATCH` lines in the response
